svg.title: An adaptive estimate must distinguish wanted motion from receiver drift
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: An adaptive estimate must distinguish wanted motion from receiver drift
L(f)=1/(1+jf/0.1Hz); small unwrapped phase; no fade
All three models track the same receiver-drift term
At 0.01 Hz, science-derived tracking retains only 0.09950 of wanted phase amplitude.
An electronically isolated pilot preserves only the paths it actually samples.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
